<module id="alu">
    <description>An Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) designed for use in a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU. This ALU supports a variety of arithmetic and logical operations, including addition, subtraction, bitwise AND, OR, XOR, NOR, set less than (SLT), set less than unsigned (SLTU), logical shifts left/right/variable (SLL, SRL, SRA, SLLV, SRLV, SRAV), and load upper immediate (LUI).</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Another 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Flag indicating whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Flag indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Flag indicating whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Flag indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag output, typically used for comparison results like SLT and SLTU.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="signed_a" src="a" />
        <assign id="signed_b" src="b" />
        <assign id="res[31:0]" src="r" />
        <assign id="flag" src="flag" />
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Define parameters for ALU operations
        parameter ADD = 6'b100000;
        parameter ADDU = 6'b100001;
        parameter SUB = 6'b100010;
        parameter SUBU = 6'b100011;
        parameter AND = 6'b100100;
        parameter OR = 6'b100101;
        parameter XOR = 6'b100110;
        parameter NOR = 6'b100111;
        parameter SLT = 6'b101010;
        parameter SLTU = 6'b101011;
        parameter SLL = 6'b000000;
        parameter SRL = 6'b000010;
        parameter SRA = 6'b000011;
        parameter SLLV = 6'b000100;
        parameter SRLV = 6'b000110;
        parameter SRAV = 6'b000111;
        parameter LUI = 6'b001111;
        
        // Internal variables
        reg [31:0] res;
        reg flag;
        
        // Assign outputs based on internal calculations
        assign r = res[31:0];
        assign flag = (aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU) ? 1 : 1'bz;
        assign zero = (res == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        assign carry = 1'bz;
        assign negative = res[31];
        assign overflow = 1'bz;
        
        // Perform operations based on control signal
        always @(*) begin
            case(aluc)
                ADD: res = signed_a + signed_b;
                ADDU: res = a + b;
                SUB: res = signed_a - signed_b;
                SUBU: res = a - b;
                AND: res = a & b;
                OR: res = a | b;
                XOR: res = a ^ b;
                NOR: res = ~(a | b);
                SLT: res = (signed_a < signed_b) ? 1 : 0;
                SLTU: res = (a < b) ? 1 : 0;
                SLL: res = b << a[4:0]; // Shift left by a[4:0]
                SRL: res = b >> a[4:0]; // Shift right by a[4:0]
                SRA: res = signed_b >>> a[4:0]; // Arithmetic shift right by a[4:0]
                SLLV: res = b << a[4:0]; // Variable shift left by a[4:0]
                SRLV: res = b >> a[4:0]; // Variable shift right by a[4:0]
                SRAV: res = signed_b >>> a[4:0]; // Variable arithmetic shift right by a[4:0]
                LUI: res = {a[31:16], 16'h0}; // Load upper immediate
                default: res = 32'hzzzzzzzz; // Default case
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
